rules.covers: an experiment launch carries RAK_PREREG=<id>, frozen, with its prereg, verdict script, frozen files and trees unchanged
reading results carries the id, and its gate is PASS against the frozen files
no shell edit or delete of a committed results doc
an edit of a committed results doc keeps every committed body line
no whole-tree git add / commit -a in a shared working tree
no file tool under the plugin's trees/
no command naming a lifecycle tree unless it starts read-only
no file tool writes the policy engine, its rules, the hooks, .rak/, .claude/ or .mcp.json
